description:
Lightweight, high-performance desktop database management tool for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and Oracle.

Lightweight, high-performance desktop database management tool built with Vue 3 and a Rust-based backend extension.
What's Changed
🐛 Bug Fixes
- fix: enable lob prefetching and robust locator reads in oracle driver by @vantoan1511 in #81
- fix(oracle): disable statement cache to prevent TTC error on refresh by @vantoan1511 in #86
- fix(ci): pin oracledb and isolate backend build in release workflow by @vantoan1511 in #88
🛠 Maintenance & Refactoring
- refactor(db-bridge): decompose monolithic oracle driver into submodules by @vantoan1511 in #82
- refactor(db-bridge): decompose monolithic postgres driver into submodules by @vantoan1511 in #83
- refactor(postgres): use PostgresType enum for column type matching by @vantoan1511 in #84
- chore: release v0.7.1 by @vantoan1511 in #87
